notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.2 prints format 1 "SEND cd-name-1 FROM identifier-1" and format 2 with an optional FROM, a required WITH identifier-2/ESI/EMI/EGI, an optional BEFORE/AFTER ADVANCING {identifier-3|integer-1 [LINE|LINES] | mnemonic-name-1 | PAGE} and an optional REPLACING [LINE]. CobolCommunication.g4#communicationSendStatement is exactly those two alternatives (sendIndicator, sendAdvancingPhrase, sendReplacingPhrase), the statement arm in CobolParserCore.g4 sends a SEND whose operand is a cd-name there, and VersionConformancePass#VisitMessagingSendStatement refuses the 2023 message-server SEND at 85 (COBOL0900); CommunicationBinder#BindSend binds it. Witness refuses SEND OUT-CD. (COBOL0001). Probes at --std 85: (b) accepted and ran: format 1, format 2 without FROM, BEFORE ADVANCING 2 LINES, AFTER 3, AFTER ADVANCING PAGE, AFTER ADVANCING mnemonic, WITH identifier-2 + identifier-3 LINE + REPLACING LINE, REPLACING alone, EMI without WITH; refused: SEND cd alone, ADVANCING or REPLACING in format 1, WITH twice, ADVANCING twice, REPLACING before ADVANCING, PAGE LINES, literal FROM, FROM twice, REPLACING twice, empty WITH, literal identifier-2, ADVANCING with no operand, no cd-name (COBOL0001/2269/5506); (c) END-SEND refused (COBOL0001), SEND TO "X" FROM ... RETURNING ... END-SEND refused COBOL0900; at --std 2023 the communication SEND is COBOL0902; (a/d) ODO, ref-mod, subscripted, numeric/edited/group and function identifier-1 forms accepted and ran (see GR3).

next.reason: 1985: "SEND cd-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] WITH identifier-2 / WITH ESI / WITH EMI / WITH EGI ... BEFORE/AFTER ADVANCING"; 2023: "SEND TO {literal-1|message-server-name-1} FROM identifier-1 RETURNING data-name-1 ... END-SEND (no cd-name formats)". 2023 SEND only sends to message servers. No cd-name, ESI/EMI/EGI, ADVANCING or REPLACING LINE form remains: the Communication-module SEND is dropped.
